notes: IT1-IT5: element claims per subject (components and responsibilities); IT6-IT11: relation claims; IT12-IT13: interaction claims of scenario 'register user'.
Overview-level package grain not used: detail_level is detailed, so components are anchored on classes.
UserDTO (helper) is not claimed as an element: it is returned by AuthenticationController, LibraryFacade and UserManager and would stay an own component; it appears only in message labels.
is-part-of relations are derived from the package/layer layout of the repository card (package statements), not from claims.
